note: Spend concentration and diagnosis lookups. Spend = allowed amount on paid medical claims plus payer + patient paid on pharmacy claims (the vbc engine's cost basis).

rules.description: The N members with the highest spend in a period and the share of total spend they represent
rules.pattern: ^which {n} (?:members|patients) account for the most (?:spend|spending|cost|costs) {period?},? and what share of (?:the |our )?total (?:cost|costs|spend|spending) do they represent$

plan.query: WITH s AS (SELECT patient_id, allowed_cents AS c FROM claim WHERE final_status = 'paid' AND {period.where:service_date} UNION ALL SELECT patient_id, coalesce(json_extract(payload, '$.payer_paid_cents'), 0) + coalesce(json_extract(payload, '$.patient_paid_cents'), 0) FROM record WHERE stream = 'pharmacy_claims' AND {period.where:event_date}), t AS (SELECT patient_id, sum(c) AS cents FROM s GROUP BY 1), top AS (SELECT patient_id, cents FROM t ORDER BY cents DESC, patient_id LIMIT {n.value}) SELECT patient_id, round(cents / 100.0, 2) AS spend_usd, round(100.0 * cents / (SELECT sum(cents) FROM t), 3) AS pct_of_total_spend, round(100.0 * (SELECT sum(cents) FROM top) / (SELECT sum(cents) FROM t), 2) AS top_group_pct_of_total_spend FROM top ORDER BY cents DESC, patient_id
plan.purpose: Top {n.value} members by spend (allowed on paid medical claims + pharmacy paid), {period.start}..{period.end}, each member's and the group's share of total spend

positives.question: Which 100 members account for the most spend this year, and what share of total cost do they represent?

negatives: Which 100 members account for the most spend this year, and what share of total cost do they represent, by practice?
Which 100 members account for the most spend this year, and why?

rules.description: Members whose spend in a period exceeds a dollar threshold, and their share of total spend
rules.pattern: ^who are (?:our |the )?high[- ]cost claimants (?:over|above|with more than|exceeding) \${amount} {period?},? and what share of (?:the |our )?total (?:spend|spending|cost|costs) do they account for$

plan.query: WITH s AS (SELECT patient_id, allowed_cents AS c FROM claim WHERE final_status = 'paid' AND {period.where:service_date} UNION ALL SELECT patient_id, coalesce(json_extract(payload, '$.payer_paid_cents'), 0) + coalesce(json_extract(payload, '$.patient_paid_cents'), 0) FROM record WHERE stream = 'pharmacy_claims' AND {period.where:event_date}), t AS (SELECT patient_id, sum(c) AS cents FROM s GROUP BY 1), hc AS (SELECT patient_id, cents FROM t WHERE cents > {amount.value} * 100) SELECT 'all high-cost claimants' AS patient_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM hc) AS claimants, round((SELECT coalesce(sum(cents), 0) FROM hc) / 100.0, 2) AS spend_usd, round(100.0 * (SELECT coalesce(sum(cents), 0) FROM hc) / (SELECT sum(cents) FROM t), 2) AS pct_of_total_spend UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT patient_id, 1, round(cents / 100.0, 2), round(100.0 * cents / (SELECT sum(cents) FROM t), 3) FROM hc ORDER BY cents DESC)
plan.purpose: Members with spend above ${amount.value} ({period.start}..{period.end}; allowed on paid medical claims + pharmacy paid): first row = the group total and its share of all spend, then each claimant

positives.question: Who are our high-cost claimants over $250,000 this year and what share of total spend do they account for?

negatives: Who are our high-cost claimants over $250,000 this year and what share of total spend do they account for, by practice?
Who are our high-cost claimants over $250,000 next year?

rules.description: Payer mix (coverage type) by gross charges and by visits
rules.pattern: ^what is (?:our |the )?payer mix by (?:gross )?charges and by visits {period?}$

plan.query: WITH ch AS (SELECT p.coverage_type AS cov, sum(c.billed_cents) AS cents FROM claim c JOIN patient p ON p.patient_id = c.patient_id WHERE {period.where:c.service_date} GROUP BY 1), vi AS (SELECT p.coverage_type AS cov, count(*) AS n FROM visit v JOIN patient p ON p.patient_id = v.patient_id WHERE v.type_concept IS NOT NULL AND v.type_concept <> 'telehealth_contact' AND {period.where:v.event_date} GROUP BY 1), k AS (SELECT cov FROM ch UNION SELECT cov FROM vi) SELECT k.cov AS coverage_type, round(coalesce(ch.cents, 0) / 100.0, 2) AS gross_charges_usd, round(100.0 * coalesce(ch.cents, 0) / (SELECT sum(cents) FROM ch), 2) AS pct_of_charges, coalesce(vi.n, 0) AS visits, round(100.0 * coalesce(vi.n, 0) / (SELECT sum(n) FROM vi), 2) AS pct_of_visits FROM k LEFT JOIN ch ON ch.cov = k.cov LEFT JOIN vi ON vi.cov = k.cov ORDER BY gross_charges_usd DESC
plan.purpose: Billed charges on medical claims and in-person/facility visits (telehealth contacts excluded) by the patient's current coverage type (uninsured = self-pay)

positives.question: What is our payer mix by gross charges and by visits (commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, self-pay)?

negatives: What is our payer mix by gross charges and by visits, by practice?
What is our payer mix by net revenue?

rules.description: Most frequent principal diagnoses on ED (or urgent care) visits that did not end in an admission
rules.pattern: ^what (?:were|are|is) (?:the )?top {n} (?:principal )?diagnos[ie]s (?:for|on|of) {encounter} (?:that did not result in|that didn't result in|not resulting in|without|that did not lead to|that did not end in) (?:an? )?(?:inpatient )?admissions? {period?}$

plan.query: SELECT principal_icd10 AS icd10, count(*) AS visits, count(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patients FROM visit WHERE {encounter.pred} AND principal_icd10 IS NOT NULL AND (disposition IS NULL OR disposition NOT IN ('admitted', 'inpatient_admission')) AND {period.where:event_date} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY visits DESC, icd10 LIMIT {n.value}
plan.purpose: Top {n.value} principal ICD-10 codes on {encounter.value} whose disposition was not an admission ({period.start}..{period.end})

positives.question: What were the top 10 diagnoses for ED visits that did not result in admission?

negatives: What were the top 10 diagnoses for ED visits that did not result in admission, by practice?
What were the top 10 diagnoses for ED visits that were avoidable?
